value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre has Parent and Tot for 18 months to 3.11 yrs, fall session Sept 12 to Dec 18, registration opened July 20 - their site says; I could not pin down the price. They also have a Pre-school Drop In Tue and Thu 9:30-12, $15 per family, their site says. I'll keep watching and text you if more is posted.
